تختزلي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَزِلِي (taḵtazilī) /tax.ta.zi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# تُخْتَزَلِي (tuḵtazalī) /tux.ta.za.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
